svg.title: How tokenized securities fit together
svg.desc: 1 Issue: an issuer and transfer agent create a security token on a shared 24/7 ledger; 2 Approve buyers: only allowlisted, KYC'd wallets can hold it. Trade and settle: 3a orders are matched on a venue (order book or RFQ on an exchange, ATS or broker, or an AMM pool; matching off- or on-chain); 3b checks confirm eligibility and that both legs are pre-funded; 3c a smart contract swaps the security token for a cash token in one transaction (atomic DvP), final on-chain instead of T+1 via CCP and CSD; 3d balances update and the register is updated or reconciled. 4 Pay holders: dividends, votes and redemptions flow back through the token. Inset: native tokens are the register; wrapped tokens are claims on shares held by a custodian.
